title: Clearances for Type I hood.
officialText:
A Type I hood shall be installed with a clearance to combustibles of not less than 18 inches (457
mm).
Exception: Clearance shall not be required from gypsum wallboard or ½-inch (12.7 mm) or thicker cementitious wallboard attached to
noncombustible structures provided that a smooth, cleanable, nonabsorbent and noncombustible material is installed between the hood
and the gypsum or cementitious wallboard over an area extending not less than 18 inches (457 mm) in all directions from the hood.
